mentions.name: Nimbalyst
mentions.description: A local, agent-native workspace for collaborating with a coding agent visually. It combines sessions, markdown, mockups, code, and tasks in one place, using visual output to the human and voice input from the human to maximize the speed and bandwidth of human-agent collaboration and reach shared context faster.
mentions.problem: Human-agent collaboration with coding agents and teams is slow to reach shared context; the project aims to maximize collaboration speed and bandwidth through visual input for the human and voice input for the agent.
mentions.audience: developers working with coding agents and teams
mentions.source_excerpt: we are working on a local, agent-native workspace where you can collaborate with your coding agent visually in your sessions, markdown, mockups, code, tasks, etc... Called Nimbalyst.
